name: The Branch of Cenarius
label: Quest
description: Following a desperate plea from the dying dryad Anilia, an adventurer is tasked with recovering a sacred relic stolen by the vile satyr Geltharis.…
intro: Following a desperate plea from the dying dryad Anilia, an adventurer is tasked with recovering a sacred relic stolen by the vile satyr Geltharis. Reclaiming the Branch of Cenarius means confronting the demon-sworn corrupters lurking in eastern Ashenvale and returning the treasured bough to Forest Song.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Anilia puts her hands on your shoulders and draws you close. Gasping, she points towards the arch to the north, before her eyes close and her last wheezing breath leaves her body. "He has taken it... Geltharis..." You know in your heart that Anilia's dying wish is to see the Branch of Cenarius back in dryad hands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found them? What did Anilia say? Where is she?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Anilia died? No... That can't be! It was just yesterday that we were running and playing together in the woods.
I guess those days are over...
